Chapter 1029: 1 A Simple Retreat (Vote For Monthly Ticket)

Chapter 1029: Chapter 1 A Simple Retreat (Vote for Monthly Ticket)

In just ten months.

The ‘Fragmented World’ of Starlight Tears was completely transformed from top to bottom.

Various futuristic and technologically-advanced buildings sprang up, and the Virtual World network was fully implemented.

Throughout the process, everything proceeded smoothly.

At the same time, internal trade within human civilization was re-established, even extending to trade routes with Ancient Ming’s Chaos Continent.

The countless human citizens of this new home… felt that apart from the absence of a visible starry sky, their life here was no different from life within the vast universe.

In fact, it was even better and more comfortable. “This is the house allocated for me to live in? It’s so spacious, and it’s completely free?” “Our new home is managed by the government, which allocates housing, jobs, medical services, and education. It’s incredible.” “Yes, honestly, I thought migrating to a new home would mean starting from scratch and living a difficult life.”

The citizens settling into the ‘Fragmented World’ of Starlight Tears adapted quickly, primarily because the benefits and welfare not only remained, but were significantly improved.

And more crucially— “My son was just born, and he has evolutionary talents. He’ll become an Evolver in the future.” “My daughter does as well.” “All of yours? My grandson’s test results showed his evolutionary talents are pretty good too.”

The world of Starlight Tears was imbued with a gentle force unique to its Fragmented World, greatly benefiting the process of life creation, including but not limited to enhancing the potential of newborns and extending lifespans.

In the universe, countless citizens are required to produce even one individual with evolutionary talent, but here, in this Fragmented World, almost every newborn carried such talents to varying degrees.

The emergence of vast numbers of foundational Evolvers increased the probability of mid-level and high-level Evolvers being born, thus creating a virtuous cycle where the development of human civilization would far outpace that within the universe. …

The newly-established core of human civilization.

Lin Yuan was discussing with nine Ultimate Beings how to deal with those aliens who had entirely pledged themselves to human civilization.

Under the universal cataclysm, many aliens who hadn’t been integrated into their respective Twelve-Layers Inner Universe opted to fully surrender to human civilization in a desperate bid for survival. “These aliens fought against human civilization for so many years. What should we do with them now?” asked the Void God Ultimate Being. “In my opinion, we should just sell them. If I remember correctly, Ancient Ming’s Chaos Continent has a demand for this,” the Ancient Power Supreme Being spoke bluntly. He harbored little goodwill toward these aliens; were it not for Lin Yuan, he wouldn’t have bothered saving them at all. “They’re all lifeforms below Twelve Layers. Even if sold to merchants, they wouldn’t fetch much,” the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being remarked. “Why not cultivate them instead to make them an asset for human civilization? Right now, in this Chaos Void, our civilization is still weak; we need to pool all resources for development.”

The various peak ethnic groups across the universe, having engaged in prolonged conflict with human civilization, undoubtedly possessed strengths worth leveraging.

Added to that was their mutual familiarity, making them relatively convenient to utilize. “That could work. However, the resources allocated for their development should be limited. I wouldn’t want to see these aliens regain their strength and oppose us again in the future.” “Regain their strength? With the Galaxy in play, what could they use to stage a resurgence?” “True.” “Still, even so, restrictions are necessary.”

The nine Ultimate Beings quickly reached a consensus.

The plan was to allocate certain resources to these aliens, aiding their development and ultimately fostering the collective progression of human civilization.

Different peak ethnic groups possessed unique advantages.

Take the Insect Race, for example—the most fiercely combative alien race against human civilization. Their Queens could birth countless Insect Race Warriors, who could easily serve as expendable forces for exploring dangerous regions.

As for deploying intelligent machines for exploration? Chaos Void’s numerous perilous areas often disrupted machines, causing malfunctions.

Of course, any cultivation efforts by human civilization would be limited purely to the new generation of aliens; the older generation of Alien Strong Ones remained tightly restricted. “Galaxy, how do you plan to handle those Twelve Layers ones?”

The Xuanyuan Supreme looked curiously toward Lin Yuan for answers. “Them…”

Lin Yuan smiled faintly. “They’ve all already been bound with prohibitions. Let’s leave it for later.”

Bringing these Twelve Layers aliens out was a decision Lin Yuan made casually; even without doing so, the Universal Origin Source consciousness would have done everything to obstruct him anyway.

Besides.

Bringing these Twelve Layers aliens with him also served to prevent any leakage of information about him.

Lin Yuan’s growth speed within the universe was astonishing even by Chaos Void standards.

These Twelve Layers aliens knew too much, and letting them go with loose tongues would pose a security risk. “Speaking of which, there’s one more matter.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme smiled and said, “I remember Galaxy mentioning that within Ancient Ming’s Chaos Continent, there’s a place specializing in the trade of Twelve Layers evolutionary pathways?” “Indeed,”

Lin Yuan nodded.

When Lin Yuan had first arrived at Ancient Ming’s Chaos Continent, he learned of this: the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion offered desired Twelve Layers evolutionary pathways.

The Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion ensured that these Twelve Layers pathways were unobstructed by ultimate existences, allowing unhindered progress.

Its background was unfathomably vast; even the pavilion in Ancient Ming’s Chaos Continent was merely a branch, and its influence spanned multiple Chaos Continents. “We’re planning to purchase several Twelve Layers evolutionary pathways.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme exchanged looks with the other eight Ultimate Beings, revealing their plans. “Purchase Twelve Layers evolutionary pathways?”

Lin Yuan speculated on their rationale.

Numerous human civilization Evolvers entering Chaos Void gradually transitioned their life essence into the mainstream timelines of Chaos Void.

With the environmental ceiling raised, many Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers were gearing up to make their ultimate leaps, attempting to step into Twelve Layers.
